block_row: Structural top of the APB I2S controller.

frame_row: Structural top of the APB I2S controller. It holds no logic: it instantiates the register block, the FIFOs, the frame engines and the support blocks. The APB domain is on the left, the master clock domain on the right.

label: u_csr_i2s
(m_vlsit_csr_i2s)
blocks.function: Generated register block of the APB completer. It decodes addresses, answers the bus with one wait state, holds every software-visible field and reports register read and write events.

label: u_regctl
(m_vlsit_i2s_regctl)
blocks.function: Register control. It turns data register events into FIFO push and pop actions in the fixed line order, runs the flush and reset requests, and builds the status and level fields.

label: u_irq
(m_vlsit_i2s_irq)
blocks.function: Interrupt logic. It sets the raw causes from events and levels, applies the injection and the enable, builds the masked status and drives the single interrupt output.

label: u_dmahs_tx, u_dmahs_rx
(m_vlsit_i2s_dmahs)
blocks.function: DMA handshake. For each direction it raises the request from the watermark condition, holds it until the acknowledge, and drives the single indication.

label: u_rstsync_apb
(m_vlsit_rst_sync)
blocks.function: Reset synchronizer of the APB domain. It asserts the local reset asynchronously and releases it synchronously to the APB clock.

label: u_cfgsync_tx, u_cfgsync_rx
(m_vlsit_i2s_cfgsync)
blocks.function: Configuration and event crossing. It carries the configuration snapshot, the slot mask and the flush and reset requests to the master clock domain, and the events and flags back.

label: u_txfifo
(m_vlsit_i2s_txfifo)
blocks.function: Transmit FIFO. One FIFO per data line, written from the APB side and read from the serial side across the clock boundary.

label: u_rxfifo
(m_vlsit_i2s_rxfifo)
blocks.function: Receive FIFO. One FIFO per data line, written from the serial side and read from the APB side across the clock boundary.

label: u_frame_0
(m_vlsit_i2s_frame)
blocks.function: Frame engine of the transmit unit. It makes or follows the bit clock and the frame sync, counts bits and slots, runs the unit state machine and detects errors and timeouts.

label: u_txser
(m_vlsit_i2s_txser)
blocks.function: Transmit serializer. It loads one word per line at each enabled slot, shifts it out most significant bit first, pads and masks the slot, and drives the data lines and their output enable.

label: u_rxdes
(m_vlsit_i2s_rxdes)
blocks.function: Receive deserializer. It samples each data line, assembles the word, aligns or packs it and pushes it at the end of each enabled slot.

label: u_frame_1
(m_vlsit_i2s_frame)
blocks.function: Frame engine of the receive unit. It makes or follows the bit clock and the frame sync, counts bits and slots, runs the unit state machine and detects errors and timeouts.

label: u_rstsync_mclk
(m_vlsit_rst_sync)
blocks.function: Reset synchronizer of the master clock domain. It asserts the local reset asynchronously and releases it synchronously to the master clock.

interfaces.name: APB4 completer interface (CLK-APB)
interfaces.signals: external requester -> IP: i_apb_psel, i_apb_penable, i_apb_pwrite, i_apb_paddr, i_apb_pwdata, i_apb_pstrb, i_apb_pprot; IP -> external requester: o_apb_pready, o_apb_pslverr, o_apb_prdata

interfaces.name: Static CSR option inputs (CLK-APB)
interfaces.signals: SoC -> IP: i_protect_en, i_slverr_en

interfaces.name: Interrupt output (CLK-APB)
interfaces.signals: IP -> interrupt controller: o_int_i2s

interfaces.name: DMA handshake (CLK-APB)
interfaces.active: IP -> DMA controller (request, single); DMA controller -> IP (acknowledge)
interfaces.signals: IP -> DMA controller: o_dma_tx_req, o_dma_tx_single, o_dma_rx_req, o_dma_rx_single; DMA controller -> IP: i_dma_tx_ack, i_dma_rx_ack

interfaces.name: Clock and reset of the APB domain
interfaces.signals: i_clk_apb, i_rst_n_apb (reset: level, active-low)

interfaces.name: Transmit bit clock and frame sync pins (CLK-MCLK)
interfaces.signals: IP -> external: o_bclk_tx, o_bclk_tx_oe, o_ws_tx, o_ws_tx_oe; external -> IP: i_bclk_tx, i_ws_tx

interfaces.name: Transmit data lines (CLK-MCLK)
interfaces.signals: IP -> external: o_sdo_0 to o_sdo_3, o_sdo_oe

interfaces.name: Receive data lines (CLK-MCLK)
interfaces.signals: external -> IP: i_sdi_0 to i_sdi_3

interfaces.name: Receive bit clock and frame sync pins (CLK-MCLK)
interfaces.signals: IP -> external: o_bclk_rx, o_bclk_rx_oe, o_ws_rx, o_ws_rx_oe; external -> IP: i_bclk_rx, i_ws_rx

interfaces.name: Clock and reset of the master clock domain
interfaces.signals: i_clk_mclk, i_rst_n_mclk (reset: level, active-low)

interfaces.name: Register fields, status and events
interfaces.signals: Field ports of the generated block; o_reg_rd_en, o_reg_rd_addr, o_reg_wr_en, o_reg_wr_addr

interfaces.name: Control fields to the crossing
interfaces.signals: Configuration, mask, enable, flush and reset fields

interfaces.name: Synchronized configuration and events
interfaces.signals: Snapshot, mask, requests; flags and events back

interfaces.name: Transmit FIFO push
interfaces.signals: Push strobe, line select, data, flush

interfaces.name: Receive FIFO pop
interfaces.signals: Pop strobe, line select, flush; head data back

interfaces.name: Cause information
interfaces.signals: Levels, flags and events used for the causes

interfaces.name: Transmit FIFO read
interfaces.signals: Pop strobe, line words

interfaces.name: Receive FIFO write
interfaces.signals: Push strobe, line words

interfaces.name: Frame events to the transmit serializer
interfaces.signals: Slot start, bit position, mask, padding

interfaces.name: Frame events to the receive deserializer
interfaces.signals: Slot start, bit sample, mask

interfaces.name: FIFO levels to the DMA handshake
interfaces.signals: Level and flags

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; blocks inside are its instances. The left column is the APB clock domain, the right column the master clock domain, the middle column crosses the boundary.
